workItem: Implement GOV-PR-UX-01 Human Decision PR Template v1.7 as a compact non-authorizing decision/evidence projection with fail-closed decision-state derivation and legacy v1.6/v1.5 compatibility.
workItemDE: GOV-PR-UX-01 Human Decision PR Template v1.7 als kompakte, nicht-autorisierende Entscheidungs-/Evidence-Projektion mit fail-closed Decision-State-Ableitung und v1.6/v1.5-Kompatibilität implementieren.
priorityReason: The PR body is the human merge decision surface; reducing duplicated metadata while preserving truthful evidence improves owner review without weakening governance.

scopeNote: Template v1.7 is presentation/evidence only. /AGENTS.md@CURRENT_MAIN remains the sole repository-wide development authority. READY_FOR_HUMAN_DECISION never grants merge authority; Human/CODEOWNER merge remains mandatory.
